BRIGADE BARCELONA · ARCHITECTURAL SHOWCASE ASSETS

All surrounding terrain, roads and planting placements are illustrative.
The documented estate access points follow the developer brochure masterplan.

Tree Small 02 by Rico Cilliers, Poly Haven, CC0 1.0.
The 1K glTF alpha map was combined with the leaf diffuse, and the geometry was simplified to 14,145 triangles before Meshopt and KTX2 export.
https://polyhaven.com/a/tree_small_02

Fern 02 by Rico Cilliers and Rob Tuytel, Poly Haven, CC0 1.0.
https://polyhaven.com/a/fern_02

Rosendal Park Sunset (Pure Sky) by Dimitrios Savva and Jarod Guest, Poly Haven, CC0 1.0.
https://polyhaven.com/a/rosendal_park_sunset_puresky

Asphalt Floor by eye-candy.xyz, Poly Haven, CC0 1.0.
https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_floor

Leafy Grass and Grey Stone Path, Poly Haven, CC0 1.0.
https://polyhaven.com/a/leafy_grass
https://polyhaven.com/a/grey_stone_path
